subject: [AMBER]  Converting a PDB trajectory to a NetCDF trajectory

messages.author: Jing Qu
messages.body:
Hi all,
Does anyone know how to convert a PDB trajectory to a NetCDF trajectory
format? I have seen the previous mailing list, say I could use:
trajin result.pdb
trajout result.nc netcdf
After I did that, it showed:
Error: No topology selected or no topologies present.
1 errors encountered reading input.
But I remembered it is said that we don't need to provide the topologies in
another answer. And my pdb trajectory could be opened by VMD, so the
topology should be present.
Best,
Jing

messages.author: SATYAJIT KHATUA
messages.body:
Hi,
Have you tried with topology? As per the error is reported, try running the script by adding topology.
Best,

messages.author: Daniel Roe
messages.body:
Hi,
You need to also specify a topology file. So just add 'parm
result.pdb' before 'trajin result.pdb'. Or just do it from the command
line:
cpptraj -p result.pdb -y result.pdb -x result.nc
Hope this helps,
-Dan
